MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 36
   C. 90
   D. 18

2. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 11
   C. 5
   D. 25

3. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 144
   C. 24
   D. 48

4. Solve for x: x + 6 = 17. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 12
   C. 11
   D. 6

5. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 65
   B. 16
   C. 64
   D. 0

6. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 10

7. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 13
   C. 26
   D. 169

8. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 5
   C. 10
   D. 25

9. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 7
   C. 5
   D. 1

10. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 9 cm³
   B. 27 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 12 cm³

11. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 33
   C. 32
   D. 4

12. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 10

13. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 7
   C. 50
   D. 49

14. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 400

15. Solve for x: x + 3 = 12. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 12
   C. 3
   D. 9

16. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 36
   C. 24
   D. 42

17. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 33
   C. 32
   D. 12

18. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x = 5
   B. x ≥ 0 only
   C. x > 5
   D. x < 5

19. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 9
   C. 18
   D. 81

20. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 24
   C. 10
   D. 25

21. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 10 000 m²
   B. 1000 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 100 m²

22. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 5
   C. 36
   D. 13

23. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 40

24. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 31
   C. 27
   D. 17

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
